descriptions: My landlord taped a notice to quit on my door and I'm three weeks behind on rent after my hours got cut.
There is black mold in the bathroom and no heat since October; the landlord ignores my repair requests.
They denied my food stamps and said I have an overpayment I don't understand.
A debt collector is suing me over an old credit card and threatened wage garnishment.
My partner hit me and I'm scared; I think I need a restraining order.
I wasn't paid for six weeks of overtime at my last job.
I want to get my criminal record expunged so background checks stop killing my applications.
My neighbor's tree fell into my yard and now the HOA is fining me over the fence.
The city reassessed my property taxes and I think the formula is wrong.
